status_legend.limited_rules: A narrow local pattern rule exists; this is not comprehensive detection.
status_legend.not_implemented: No detector is implemented for this category.

categories.name: Financial and payment scams
items: Card, wallet, loan, and insurance fraud
Investment, cryptocurrency, Ponzi, and advance-fee fraud
categories.limitations: Only a few payment, OTP, and wording clues are checked. Recipient and transaction ownership are not verified.

categories.name: Identity and impersonation scams
items: Bank, government, police, or company impersonation
categories.limitations: No identity, sender, brand, voice, or video authenticity verification.

categories.name: Communication scams
categories.limitations: Small English phrase list; no email header, sender, call, or account integration.

categories.name: Employment and education scams
categories.limitations: A few job and fee phrases only; employer, institution, or offer is not verified.

categories.name: E-commerce and marketplace scams
categories.limitations: No merchant, listing, delivery, product, or review verification.

categories.name: Relationship and personal scams
categories.limitations: No relationship, profile, identity, or media analysis.

categories.name: Technology and malware threats
categories.limitations: APK/archive metadata and wording clues only; no antivirus, manifest permissions, extension, or runtime analysis.

categories.name: Investment and emerging scams
items: Fake crypto exchanges or trading apps
categories.limitations: No financial, influencer, wallet, advertisement, or media verification.

categories.name: Government and public-service scams
categories.limitations: Only generic KYC and urgency terms may match; no official agency or domain allowlist verification.

categories.name: Unknown and emerging scams
categories.limitations: No anomaly model or campaign intelligence. A missing rule match does not establish safety.
